title: 12 Best Photography Spots in Abu Dhabi
description: Discover Abu Dhabi's most picturesque locations for stunning photography. From architectural marvels to serene natural landscapes, find your next perfect shot.

places.name: Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A wide-angle shot of the grand courtyard with its reflecting pools, capturing the symmetrical domes and minarets.

places.name: Louvre Abu Dhabi
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Capturing the 'rain of light' effect under the dome, especially when the sun is high, or exterior shots showcasing the dome's intricate patterns and reflections on the water.

places.name: Qasr Al Watan (Presidential Palace)
places.priceRange: AED 65 (approx. $18) for Palace in Motion ticket
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The symmetrical grandeur of the Grand Hall and its central dome, capturing the intricate details and vast scale.

places.name: Emirates Palace Mandarin Oriental
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The grand lobby and its golden archways, or the exterior facade with its iconic domes against the blue sky.

places.name: Abu Dhabi Corniche
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A wide shot capturing the city skyline at sunset from the beach, or dynamic photos of cyclists and families enjoying the promenade.

places.name: Jubail Mangrove Park
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The long wooden boardwalks leading into the mangroves, especially at sunrise or sunset for dramatic lighting and reflections.

places.name: Yas Bay Waterfront
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A long exposure shot of the waterfront lights reflecting on the water at night, or dynamic candid shots of the bustling restaurant scene.

places.name: Ferrari World Abu Dhabi (Exterior)
places.priceRange: Free for exterior photos; theme park entry AED 310 (approx. $84)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A wide-angle shot of the distinctive red roof from the outside, capturing its massive scale and unique design against the blue sky.

places.name: Heritage Village
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The traditional watchtower or the beach area looking back at the modern skyline, creating a compelling contrast between old and new Abu Dhabi.

places.name: Capital Gate (Leaning Tower of Abu Dhabi)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A wide shot from the ground up to emphasize its lean, or incorporate it into an urban landscape with surrounding buildings for context.

places.name: Saadiyat Beach
places.priceRange: Access to public beach AED 35 (approx. $9.5) or free if staying at a resort
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Long exposure shots of the gentle waves at sunrise or sunset, capturing the natural beauty and calm atmosphere.

places.name: Observation Deck at 300 (Jumeirah at Etihad Towers)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A sweeping panorama of the cityscape, especially at twilight as the city lights begin to twinkle, offering both day and night views.
